name: learn-harness
description: Turn a Claude project or a folder into a learning harness for one subject. Lesson sessions probe your edge, plan a minimal dependency tree, and teach one checked reasoning step at a time; Practice sessions train retrieval with a hint ladder; Field sessions grade an artifact you produce against a pre-committed rubric. A knowledge graph, an append-only ledger and a frontier record carry it across sessions. Adapted from learnharness.
